Author: dajoey
Name: Lazy FATE Automator
Description: Fully automated FATE grinding using vnavmesh IPC, Mount Roulette / Dismount via ActionManager, Gluttony Combo IPC for combat, and a priority-aware sort engine ported from CBT (Croizat's Bundle of Tweaks / Automaton).
Punchline: Fully automated FATE grinding utilizing vnavmesh, lifestream, and Gluttony Combo.
Changelog:
v0.0.2.0 - Major rewrite. NavigationHelper now uses vnavmesh IPC subscribers (SimpleMove.PathfindAndMoveTo, Path.IsRunning, Query.Mesh.NearestPointReachable) instead of chat commands. Stuck detection uses live navmesh state. FATESolver fixes the operator-precedence bug in NPC matching, drops magic-string sort criteria for a typed enum + descending toggle, and adds a deterministic tiebreaker. State machine re-evaluates the target FATE every tick so higher-priority FATEs preempt mid-path. Configuration has a real Version migration scaffold; bad values are clamped. Tick loop has try/catch with exponential backoff (auto-stops after 5 consecutive errors). New /lazyfate start|stop|toggle|status subcommands. UI: sort-order editor, eligibility highlighting, distance column, Gluttony lease indicator, ImGui % escaping.
v0.0.1.3 - Fix movement stutter.
v0.0.1.2 - Fix mount/dismount enum + IDs.
v0.0.1 - Initial development version.
